instruction: Adjust VLC settings to prevent multiple instances and ensure all files open in one application window.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling multiple instance mode in VLC (one-instance-when-started-from-file=0). Evaluator uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric and get_vlc_config getter to read VLC configuration file and verify one-instance-when-started-from-file setting is set to 0. Default value is 1 (allows multiple instances), so the agent must navigate to Tools > Preferences > Interface and disable 'Allow only one instance when started from file manager'. This is similar in complexity to the original task (changing a single VLC configuration setting).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly retrieves VLC configuration file from OS-specific paths (Linux: ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc, Darwin: ~/Library/Preferences/org.videolan.vlc/vlcrc, Windows: ~\AppData\Roaming\vlc\vlcrc)
Metric (check_one_instance_when_started_from_file) correctly reads the config file and searches for 'one-instance-when-started-from-file=' setting

Expected value is semantically correct: expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file=0 means 'disable multiple instances' which aligns with instruction requirement to 'use only one instance when started from a file'
Metric handles default value correctly: if setting not found in config, defaults to '1' (multiple instances allowed), which is the correct VLC default behavior
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure configuration is saved and can be read for verification
Complete coverage: instruction has one clear requirement (configure single instance mode) which is fully verified by checking the exact VLC setting
Metric parameter handling is correct: receives 'expected' directly as rules dictionary and accesses rule['expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file'] correctly
